entity.summary: Former centralized peer-to-peer crypto marketplace that ended trading and deposit operations in 2025 and now maintains a withdrawal-only wind-down service.
entity.notes: Paxful's current first-party wind-down materials state that trading, deposits, sending, and receiving were discontinued and that remaining service is limited to withdrawals. The shutdown was announced on 2025-10-01 and became effective on 2025-11-01. No unsupported launch date, legal jurisdiction, predecessor, successor, or separate successor platform is asserted.

events.title: Paxful announces wind-down
events.description: Paxful announced its decision to wind down the marketplace and end normal business operations.
events.notes: The announcement date is confirmed retrospectively by Paxful's current first-party resolution statement.

events.title: Paxful trading operations end
events.description: Paxful discontinued trading, deposits, sending, and receiving, leaving only a withdrawal service for remaining customers.
events.notes: The effective date and withdrawal-only state are stated on Paxful's current first-party restricted-jurisdictions and limited-operations page.

evidence.title: Paxful DOJ and FinCEN resolution
evidence.notes: Current first-party statement says Paxful announced its decision to wind down on 2025-10-01 and no longer conducts business, supporting the shutdown-announced event.

evidence.title: Paxful restricted jurisdictions and limited operations
evidence.notes: Current first-party page states that limited operations took effect on 2025-11-01, all trading and transaction functions were discontinued, and only withdrawals remain available, supporting the shutdown-effective event and dead classification.
